title: 混动车这几年的最大贡献：告诉大家纯电有多香
content: Hybrid vehicles, once dominant due to range, price, and policy advantages, are now losing ground to pure electric vehicles (EVs) in China. As charging infrastructure expands, fast-charging technology improves, and battery costs drop, hybrids' core benefits have eroded. Most hybrid owners primarily drive on electricity, making the combustion engine an unnecessary burden. While hybrids still suit niche needs like long-distance travel in cold regions, the market has shifted decisively toward EVs.

title: 《欢迎来龙餐馆》：用“好好吃饭”的哲学反思战争 | 原文
content: "Welcome to Long Restaurant" uses a micro perspective to reflect on war through the philosophy of "eating well." Set in the Middle East, the film follows Xu Fu, a Northeastern Chinese man who opens a Chinese restaurant amid conflict. By transplanting the familiar bustle of Chinese dining culture to a war-torn region, it creates dramatic tension around whether everyday life can withstand destructive forces and how Chinese cuisine interacts with foreign lands.

title: Gemini 3.8 Flash 光速发布：干活挺勤快，就是没开窍
content: Google released Gemini 3.8 Flash, its third Flash model in six weeks, targeting long-haul software engineering, autonomous agents, and complex enterprise workflows. Benchmark scores show strong improvements in coding, multimodal tasks, and specialized domains like finance and law, nearing flagship models like Claude Opus 5. However, real-world testing reveals persistent issues: rapid response times mask sloppy details, rough execution, and shallow reasoning. A companion model, 3.8 Flash Cyber, focuses on vulnerability discovery for cybersecurity institutions. Google's strategy has shifted toward rapid, cost-effective Flash iterations after the failure of Gemini 3.5 Pro, prioritizing user growth and integration over frontier model competition.

title: 突发！Gemini 3.8登顶，谷歌迈出RSI一大步
content: Google released Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber, achieving near-top performance at dramatically lower costs—$0.58 per task versus competitors' much higher prices. The model scores 59 on intelligence benchmarks, close to leading models, with 305 tokens/second generation speed and strong coding performance. Google prioritized iterative optimization through reinforcement learning rather than raw parameter size. Meta countered with Muse Spark 1.3 scoring higher at lower costs, while critics noted potential benchmark overfitting. Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber excels at cybersecurity, discovering vulnerabilities in hours that previously took months, available only to trusted organizations through Google's Fairwind program.

title: Decoding the new AI lingo: Loops, harnesses, squads, hill climbing… oh my!
content: New AI terminology in software development includes loop engineering (repeatable agent workflows), Ralph loops (iterative task execution), squads/fleets (multi-agent teams with specialized roles), harnesses (systems surrounding models), and hill climbing (ongoing improvement through feedback). Other terms cover deployment roles (forward deployed engineers) and model accessibility levels: closed models (API-only), open weights (downloadable parameters), and open source models (full transparency). Many practices are repackaged existing concepts; reliable workflows, validation, and continuous improvement matter more than buzzwords.

title: How we make AI coding more cost efficient without sacrificing task quality
content: GitHub Copilot improved AI coding efficiency by optimizing complete task outcomes rather than individual tool calls. Four changes were implemented: selectively compressing repetitive output while preserving necessary context, removing unused line-number prefixes from file views, shortening prompts without losing intended behaviors, and delivering completed background work directly without requiring extra retrieval steps. Each change was validated through offline benchmarks and controlled online experiments. Key lessons include optimizing orchestration, compressing based on output type, testing prompt rewrites thoroughly, and evaluating changes in every workflow where they deploy. These modifications reduce token usage and costs without reducing model capability.
